summary.en: Yoko Okino is starring in "The Stalker Who Laughted at the Darkness", a Tuesday Suspense Drama written by Nichiuri TV, and she invites Kogoro, Ran, and Conan to watch the shooting at the Beika Shrine. The cameraman, Morio Anzai, is murdered, and next to his body is a dying message spelling out the word "komainu", meaning stone lion.

suspects: Shingo Nachi, Taeko Mamegaki, and Yuji Shimazaki
